window-1.title: Every Place at Once
window-1.blurb: It's the Every Noise map rebuilt as cities instead of genres — click Singapore and find out which places on earth are listening like you are, then fall down a rabbit hole into someone else's hometown radio.

window-2.title: Moats That Matter, Cross-Species Communication, & Taking Back Our Attention
window-2.blurb: Belsky reads the near-future like a designer rather than a tech bro, and this one detours from what makes an idea truly yours into AI-decoded animal language and clawing your attention back — basically three side quests in one newsletter.

window-4.title: 10 Ceramic Table Lamps from Contemporary Pottery Studios
window-4.blurb: One lumpy, hand-thrown ceramic lamp does more for a room than a whole furniture haul, and knowing you, you'll look at these and immediately start googling pottery classes so you can make your own.

window-5.title: Inner Teahouse, Chinatown
window-5.blurb: A second-floor shophouse teahouse born out of a pottery studio, where the cups are as considered as the tea — exactly the kind of quiet, hand-made hideout you'd claim as your own and accidentally leave with a new side quest.
